models_evaluated: deep learning ultrasound model for FTC vs FTA and invasion subtype classification

links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI assistance, and AI versus radiologists
links.effect: AI consistently outperformed radiologists and improved diagnostic accuracy as an assistive tool; no numeric effect or overreliance assessment reported in the abstract.
links.quote: It consistently outperformed radiologists and improved diagnostic accuracy as an assistive tool.

links.outcome: Model AUC across three external test sets from multiple hospitals
links.effect: AUCs of 0.816-0.847 for FTC vs FTA across external test sets; subtype AUC range 0.754-0.910; generalized well to varied clinical settings.
links.quote: The model demonstrated high diagnostic performance, with AUCs of 0.816-0.847 for FTC vs FTA discrimination across external test sets and robust performance across subtypes (AUC range 0.754-0.910), and generalized well to varied clinical settings.

screen.reason: The study develops an ultrasound deep learning model and evaluates it in a reader study comparing radiologists' diagnostic accuracy with and without AI assistance across external test sets.

primary.practice: AI-assisted clinician reading vs unassisted reading
